title: Trimmed strong laws and distributional limits for exponentially mixing systems
summary: The Birkhoff Ergodic Theorem establishes pointwise convergence for integrable observables, but for $f\notin L^1$, no normalization yields almost sure convergence. This paper investigates trimmed ergodic sums, where the largest observations are removed, for observables with polynomial tails satisfying $¶(f>t)\,t^{1/α}\to c>0$ as $t\to\infty$, in exponentially mixing dynamical systems. We prove trimmed strong laws of large numbers when $α\geq 1$, extending known results from the i.i.d.\ case.
